name: You
description: A traveller with the caravan, dust to the knees.

name: Caravan-master Iselt
description: She rides with the reins in one hand and a ledger in the other.

name: Factor Dravin
description: The Hadda house's factor, in a good coat gone creased.

name: the caravan's bales
description: Cotton bales stacked beside the wagons.

name: Sister Ama
description: A priest of the Dawn Hall, her sleeves smudged with lamp-black.

name: Archivist Tenko
description: Keeper of the guild archive, who trusts paper over people.

name: Old Garrow
description: A retired gate guard who grew up among the hill folk.

name: the cold camp
description: Firepits, a dropped cup, and tracks.

name: Rask
description: A lean bandit with a studded club.

name: Rask's lookout
description: A boy with a sling, trying to look dangerous.

name: the paved branch
description: Fitted stones running east into the hills.

name: Ennick
description: A drover from the lost wagons, hiding in the reeds.

name: the stone ring
description: Knee-high stones in a perfect circle.
